subject: Export options and residency constraints for audit/access logs
messages:
From: Audits Team <audits@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: bulk export for audit + access logs (residency + deletion)

Hi Rishi,

We're preparing for an upcoming compliance review and need a bulk export of audit and access logs for our tenant (Acme Health) covering the period 2026-01-01 through 2027-04-30. Two key constraints: all exported artifacts must never leave the EU, and we need an auditable proof that, after export delivery, Redwood will delete the copy you create for delivery within 30 days and provide an attestation.

Can you confirm:
- supported export formats (Parquet/JSONL/CSV?) and whether schema includes IP, user_id, action, resource, and full request/response bodies for admin events
- whether we can receive exports to our EU S3 bucket with CMEK (customer-managed key) wrapping the objects
- expected turnaround for a ~16-month export (~1.2 TB compressed) and any expedited options

I've attached a short workbook with the requested timeline and an initial scope.

Thanks,
Marta Alvarez
Head of Audits — Acme Health
attachments: acme_requested_scope.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Audits Team <audits@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bulk export for audit + access logs (residency + deletion)

Hi Marta — thanks for the details and the workbook. Looping in Mina (infra exports) to confirm the mechanics. A few quick answers up front:

- Formats: we support Parquet (preferred for large exports), newline-delimited JSON (JSONL), and CSV. Parquet with Snappy compression is what we generally recommend for multi-GB exports.
- Schema: export includes timestamp, tenant_id, user_id (hashed on request), action, resource_path, http_status, request_id, and for audit/admin events we can include request/response payloads as an optional layer (those increase size).
- Delivery: we can deliver to a customer-specified S3 endpoint in EU (eu-west-1 or eu-central-1) via a temporary write role that you create. CMEK support for the delivered objects is possible if you own the bucket and apply your KMS key; we do not retain the CMEK key on our side.

Mina — can you confirm ETA for a 1–1.5 TB compressed export and the deletion attestation mechanism?

Best,
Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference

From: Audits Team <audits@acmehealth.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: security_ops@acmehealth.com
Date: 2027-05-30 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bulk export for audit + access logs (residency + deletion)

Thanks Rishi — quick clarifications from our side:
- For PII risk reasons we'd like user_id hashed with a salt we control if possible. If not, please advise alternatives.
- We want request/response payloads for admin events only (not for every user request).
- The retention policy for our tenant is 365 days for audit logs, but we require a point-in-time export for the full 16 months for the review — please confirm you can export beyond what is configured as "active retention" for the tenant.

Also, is there a dry-run or small sample export we can validate before you ship the full dataset?

Regards,
Marta

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Audits Team <audits@acmehealth.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bulk export for audit + access logs (residency + deletion)

Hi Marta — technical note from infra:

- Exports beyond the active retention window: for hosted tenants we retain raw audit data up to the configured retention (default 365d). We can produce a point-in-time export that includes older artifacts only if you had archival snapshots enabled. For Acme Health I see archive snapshots enabled from 2025-11-01, so the requested 2026-01-01 start is available. If archives were missing we'd need to run a longer reconstruction which could add time.

- Hashing: we can pseudonymize user_id with an HMAC using a salt provided by you; we will not persist the salt. The export manifest will include the salt hash method used.

- Payloads: we'll restrict request/response payloads to admin/audit events only, per your ask. That reduces the export size substantially.

- Delivery mechanics: we support (A) direct write to your EU S3 bucket with an assume-role flow, (B) encrypted delivery to an SFTP endpoint hosted in EU (we will push a signed tar.gz), or (C) upload to a temporary Redwood-owned bucket in the EU region which we will then transfer to your bucket and purge after delivery. Option A with your bucket + CMEK is recommended.

- ETA: baseline delivery for a ~1.2 TB compressed Parquet export is 5 business days after scope confirmation. We offer an expedited 2 business day turnaround for exports under an expedited support engagement (fee applies).

- Sample: yes — we will produce a 1-day sample (Parquet + JSONL) within 24 hours of scope confirmation. Attached is a small compressed sample schema we use for validation.

Attachments: export_samples_parquet_snippet.gz, redwood_export_manifest_template.json

Questions for you: which delivery option do you prefer and will you provide a CMEK-enabled bucket role? Also confirm whether the attestation can be a signed statement with an export SHA256 manifest and a signed deletion timestamp.

Thanks,
Mina
Infrastructure Exports Lead — Redwood Inference

From: Audits Team <audits@acmehealth.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31 08:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bulk export for audit + access logs (residency + deletion)

Mina — thanks, that all looks sensible. We will:
- Stand up an EU (eu-west-1) S3 bucket and attach a bucket policy + KMS key under our account. We'll send a cross-account role ARN for write access.
- Provide a short-lived HMAC salt for user_id hashing; confirm you will not retain that salt after generation.
- Accept the signed SHA256 manifest + deletion timestamp attestation.

Two follow-ups: can you confirm if the export includes redacted IPs by default or if we need to request IP redaction? Also, any per-GB cost for expedited delivery?

Marta

From: Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Audits Team <audits@acmehealth.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: bulk export for audit + access logs (residency + deletion)

Hi Marta — Naomi from Compliance here, confirming the commercial and attestation side so there are no surprises:

- IPs: by default exports include full IPs as captured. We can apply automated redaction at export time (masking to /24 or removing full octet) if you request it; please confirm desired redaction level.
- Cost: normal exports are included in the standard evidence support for enterprise accounts. Expedited turnaround (2 business days) carries a surcharge: a flat project fee of $1,500 plus $0.10/GB transferred. We'll confirm final costs when we have the precise compressed size after the sample run.
- Deletion attestation: we will provide a signed attestation PDF with the export manifest (SHA256 of each file), a timestamp for when Redwood removed any copy from our temporary storage, and the identity of the engineer who executed the purge. This attestation will be stored in your HubSpot record and delivered to your security_ops contact.

Next steps we need from Acme:
1) scope confirmation + signed export request (DocuSign link to follow)
2) cross-account role ARN for eu-west-1 with write permissions
3) the HMAC salt (short-lived)
4) redaction preference for IPs ("none" | "/24" | "remove")

I'll open a support ticket and attach the standard export order form. If you want the expedited path, please note it in the signed request.

Best regards,
Naomi Feldman
Head of Compliance — Redwood Inference
attachments: redwood_export_manifest_template.json
